earnings.title: AMETEK Announces Record Third Quarter 2026 Results and Raises Full Year Guidance
highlights: GAAP operating income for the quarter was a record $584.9 million.
Adjusted operating income increased 20% to a record $594.7 million and operating margins were 26.8%, up 60 basis points from the third quarter of 2025.
Operating cash flow in the quarter was up 27% to $560.6 million and free cash flow to net income conversion was 124%.
On a GAAP basis, EIG’s third quarter operating income was a record $406.7 million.
AMETEK’s third quarter 2026 sales were a record $2.22 billion, a 17% increase over the third quarter of 2025.

quotes.text: AMETEK delivered outstanding results in the third quarter.
Our performance in the third quarter showcased the quality of our businesses, attractiveness of our end market exposures and the proven effectiveness of the AMETEK Growth Model.
